items.text: Assigning a quiz has a Modifications step. Give selected students extra time or fewer answer choices.
Add supports for those students, like a text, a link or a Drive file. A question can also have a modified version with simpler wording.
Reopen a finished quiz for only the students you select. Students who did not turn it in are listed first.
Preview a picture, passage or PDF from the question it is attached to.
Save a widget's settings as your default. Open its settings, go to Style and select Save as my default. New copies of that widget start with your settings.
When you publish scores as Score only, students no longer see which answers were right or wrong.

widgetNotes.text: Assigning a quiz has a Modifications step. Give selected students extra time or fewer answer choices.
Reopen a finished quiz for only the students you select.
Preview a picture, passage or PDF from the question it is attached to.
Add a word bank to a question. Students tap a word to fill a blank.
Fill in the Blank questions can use random numbers. Each student gets their own numbers.
Attach stimuli in a dialog. Pick one from the list and see a preview beside it.
When you publish scores as Score only, students no longer see which answers were right or wrong.
Pair students to review each other's writing. Partners can read, comment or suggest edits.
The message, picture and clothing tip follow the Feels Like temperature.
Group Maker keeps its own class when the board's class changes.
